user.title: Choose your Frigate camera
user.description: Select the camera that hears the barking. Its bark sensor is found automatically; no entity-ID typing is needed. Audio detection and the bark label must already be enabled in Frigate.

broadlink.title: Choose your Broadlink device
broadlink.description: Choose an RF-capable Broadlink device already configured in Home Assistant. No learning or transmission occurs during setup.

command.title: Choose your beep command source
command.description: Choose a named command saved by Home Assistant's Broadlink integration, or use your privately captured RF code. Setup does not learn, test, or transmit anything; the entry starts disarmed and in dry-run mode.

learned_device.title: Choose your learned device
learned_device.description: Choose a device/group saved by this Broadlink transmitter. You can also type a new name and use Learn beep after setup. If the list is empty, no readable saved groups were found. Codes used directly in scripts and devices saved only in the Broadlink app are not listed. Setup does not change Broadlink's saved commands.

data.command_device: Learned device/group (choose or type a new name)

learned_command.title: Choose your beep command
learned_command.description: Only commands saved under your chosen device/group are listed. You can type a new command name and use Learn beep after setup. Names do not prove what a command does: choose only a verified beep command, never vibration or shock. Setup sends nothing.

data.beep_command: Beep command (choose or type a new name)
data.beep_only_confirmed: I confirm this command only beeps, not vibration or shock

raw_command.title: Enter your private beep RF code
raw_command.description: Paste your own captured Broadlink RF base64 code, optionally prefixed with b64:. Never use a shock or vibration command. No learned device/group or command name is needed. Setup sends nothing; the entry starts disarmed and in dry-run mode.

data.beep_only_confirmed: I confirm this command only beeps, not vibration or shock

behavior.title: Alert settings
behavior.description: Cooldown applies to automatic alerts and manual tests. Animal fallback requires recent dog detection from this same camera. Every restart or reload resets Armed to off and Dry run to on.
